p: בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (בְּהַעֲלוֹתְךָ, זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קנב, ב)
In the holy Zohar (Behaaloscha, Zohar III 152b)
if the secret of Pesach holds sway in Nissan,
how can those who became defiled
perform it in the second month,
when its time has already passed?
דְּיָדוּעַ כִּי יֵשׁ שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא אוֹתִיּוֹת לַתּוֹרָה
it is known that the Torah has six hundred thousand letters,
and corresponding to them are six hundred thousand souls of Yisrael;
has a portion in the letters of the Torah.
וְהִנֵּה בְּעֵת עָמְדָם עַל הַר סִינַי
Now, when they stood at Har Sinai,
וְהָיוּ כֻּלָּם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד בְּלֵב אֶחָד
and they were all like one man with one heart,
to accept upon themselves the yoke of His kingship,
and they put "we will do" before "we will hear" —
the expression the ministering angels use
so that we cannot do anything
against His will, blessed be He,
שֶׁאֵין מַלְאָךְ אֶחָד עוֹשֶׂה שְׁתֵּי שְׁלִיחוּת
for one angel does not perform two missions,
from the purpose of the creation
for which he was created, for that mission.
וּכְמוֹ כֵן אָמְרוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּם כֵּן
We will do only the will of Hashem Yisbarach,
and we will be unable to do anything
against the will of Hashem Yisbarach.
And by the power of these words
עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
through Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him.
who were impure through a human corpse
either they were Mishael and Eltzafan,
אוֹ שֶׁהָיוּ נוֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹנוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף
or they were the bearers of Yosef's coffin;
וְהָיוּ פְּטוּרִין מִן הַדִּין מִפֶּסַח רִאשׁוֹן
and by law they were exempt from the first Pesach
on the grounds of being engaged in a mitzvah.
לִקְרַב לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
to come before Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
And what was the deficiency on their part?
to fulfill the mitzvah of offering the Pesach in its time
together with all of Klal Yisrael;
and over this they were greatly distressed,
that they did not merit to approach the holy
together with Klal Yisrael at its appointed time.
וְעַל זֶה הֵשִׁיב לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And to this Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, answered them,
from the depths of your hearts over this,
and through your cry and your longing
you will draw the word of Hashem down to me,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁהִמְשִׁיכוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַתּוֹרָה כּוּלָּהּ
just as Yisrael drew down the entire Torah
through the greatness of their longing;
what Hashem will command for you."
for through their prayer they brought about
which alludes that there is hope
even for one who was impure,
or was on a distant road deliberately,
and even so he brings Pesach Sheni.
"If your sins be like these years
since the six days of Creation,
they shall become white as snow" —
so that deliberate sins become like merits
(and this was explained in Lag BaOmer, maamar 2).
And the time of offering Pesach Sheni
is on the first day of the sefirah of Hod,
which alludes to Torah she'b'al peh,
about which it is said (in the Gemara, Nedarim 22b),
"For in much wisdom is much anger" —
that on the first night of Pesach
it is written, "And Hashem will pass over," etc.,
and there was an awakening from above
on the part of Hashem Yisbarach
to shine into the hearts of Bnei Yisrael
the light of His holiness, blessed be He,
and there remained in the hearts of Bnei Yisrael
which they had merited on the night of Pesach, as is known.
And for this we were commanded
which are the seven holy attributes,
so that we purify our souls
to be prepared to receive the Torah
who drew the Torah down into the world.
for Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him —
from him began the two thousand years of Torah
and he is the attribute of Chesed, the right;
and it is written, "From His right hand, a fiery law for them,"
הַיְינוּ אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה הוּא אֵשׁ דָּת
meaning: though the Torah is a fiery law,
its beginning is from the right.
And Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him —
and the Torah came forth from Gevurah.
And Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him —
as it is written, "Grant truth to Yaakov,"
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who drew down the Torah openly
after they had become a complete nation,
And Aharon HaKohen, the attribute of Hod,
as it is said, "The lips of the Kohen," etc.,
"and they shall seek Torah from his mouth."
is the drawing of the Written Torah
Yehoshua, who received the Written Torah
from Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
and from him comes the beginning of Torah she'b'al peh
after Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him.
And in Yeravam too, who came from the seed of Yosef,
הָיָה בּוֹ הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת מִתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
there was an expansion of Torah she'b'al peh,
from the words of the verse
"and the two of them were alone in the field" —
שֶׁכָּל טַעֲמֵי הַתּוֹרָה מְגוּלֶּה לָהֶם כַּשָּׂדֶה
that all the reasons of the Torah were revealed to them like a field.
וּמִדַּת מַלְכוּת דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And the attribute of Malchus is David HaMelech, peace be upon him;
מַלְכוּת פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינַן לַהּ
Malchus we call "the mouth," Torah she'b'al peh.
וְהִנֵּה בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קכט, ב)
Now in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 129b)
"In the place where the masters of teshuvah stand,
have no permission to stand," etc.,
like the one who says in the Gemara (Berachos 34b):
"In the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
And here the holy Zohar says
of those who make Pesach Sheni:
לָאו אִיהוּ כְּמַאן דְּנָטִיל פִּסְחָא בִּזְמַנֵּיהּ
"he is not like one who takes the Pesach in its time" —
like the one who says in the Gemara (ibid.):
these and those are the words of the living G-d:
who goes from strength to strength
all the days of his life without lack,
as brought in the holy Zohar (ibid.):
"'And Avraham was old, advanced in days' —
every day, from level to level" —
his level is greater than that of baalei teshuvah.
to the light of His holiness, blessed be His Name,
not in the orderly way of the paths of life —
"The leg of the hei is left hanging,
so that if he returns in teshuvah, he is brought in";
and it asks, "Let him enter through that same opening,"
by the way through which he went out,
but only by a power above him
and the Holy One, blessed be He, has mercy on him
and suddenly brings him into His palace,
as brought in the holy Zohar (ibid.):
in a single hour and a single moment,
is drawn close to Hashem Yisbarach;
he is greater than a perfect tzaddik.
(For a Pidyon HaBen on Pesach Sheni)
